map.宠物年龄换算人类年龄：犬按体型分档，头两年每年约折 12 至 15 岁，其后小型: Converting pet age to human age: dogs are banded by size, with the first two years counting as about 12 to 15 human years each, after which small dogs gain 4 to 5 years per year, medium dogs 5 to 6 and large dogs 6 to 7 (1 year equals about 15 human years, 2 years about 24); cats map to 15 and 9 human years in the first two years, then gain 4 years per year; past 7 human years enters late adulthood and past 10 enters old age, when checkups and joint and dental care should be stepped up.
map.• 猫狗1岁相当于人类15岁左右，已进入青春期: • A cat or dog at 1 year equals about 15 human years and is already in adolescence
map.• 2岁后每年增长约4-5人类岁（猫）或3-5人类岁（狗）: • After 2 years it gains about 4-5 human years per year (cats) or 3-5 human years (dogs)
map.• 大型犬衰老更快，寿命通常比小型犬短: • Large dogs age faster and usually have shorter lifespans than small dogs
map.• 7岁后进入中老年，建议增加体检频率: • After 7 years it is middle-aged or older, so increase the checkup frequency
map.• 老年宠物需调整饮食，减少热量增加纤维: • Senior pets need dietary changes, with fewer calories and more fiber
map.• 不同品种衰老速度有差异，数据为平均值: • Aging speed varies by breed, and these figures are averages

map.估算剩余陪伴时间，规划体检与护理重点。: to estimate the remaining time together and plan checkups and care priorities.
map.采用分年龄对照表线性插值：取整数岁 idx = floor(年龄)，人类年龄 =: A per-age lookup table is interpolated linearly: take the integer year idx = floor(age), human age = round(table[idx] + (table[idx+1] − table[idx]) × fraction); beyond the table, each extra year adds 4 human years. Cats and small dogs map to 15 human years in the first year and 24 in the second; in adulthood cats and small dogs gain about +4 per year, medium dogs about +4~5, large dogs about +5~6 and giant dogs about +6. Life stages (human age): 0-1 infant, 1-3 adolescent, 3-6 adult, 6-9 middle-aged, 9-13 early senior, 13+ senior. Average lifespan: cats 15 years, small dogs 15, medium 13, large 11, giant 9 years.
map.猫 3 岁 → 对照表第 3 项 = 32 人类岁（成年期）；猫 2.5 岁 =: A cat at 3 years → the third entry of the table = 32 human years (adult); a cat at 2.5 years = 28 + (32−28)×0.5 = 30 human years. A medium dog at 5 years → the fifth entry of the medium table = 42 human years; a large dog at 5 years → 45 human years, so a large dog of the same age maps to an older stage.
map.为什么不能用“1 年 = 7 岁”？: Why can't I just use '1 year = 7 years'?
map.宠物早年发育极快（1 岁即相当于人类 15 岁），之后趋缓，且与体型强相关；“乘: Pets develop extremely fast early on (1 year already equals 15 human years) and then slow down, and the mapping is strongly tied to size. Multiplying by 7 badly underestimates puppyhood and overestimates a large dog's later years, so an age-banded table is the right approach.
map.大型犬折算年龄为什么更高？: Why do large dogs map to an older age?
map.大型犬寿命短、衰老快，同样 5 岁的大型犬身体状态已相当于人类中年，而小型犬仍在: Large dogs have shorter lifespans and age faster, so a large dog at 5 is physically comparable to a human in middle age while a small dog is still in its prime, so a size-banded table reflects reality better.
